newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady in the kerb market at 39.20 to the dollar on Sunday amid dull demand for the dollar, dealers said.
One dealer said dollar demand and supply had remained in balance. "The rupee is seen opening stable on Monday," he said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on August 29, was 35.6200/35.7981 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 9.80 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
